answer.summary: One test failed: ImportBundleAttributionTest expected a successful (2xx) response but got a 400 CLIENT_ERROR from the bundle import. The log does not show the response body or the cause of the 400. The failure is a deterministic response-status assertion with no flake history, and none of the touched files is the importer, so I cannot link it to the change. Other logged exceptions (certificate, Caldera, CrowdStrike) come from tests that did not fail the build. Low confidence; check the 400 response body before retrying.
